swimming_pool.evidence: The pools visible at the upper-left and lower-right belong to neighboring lots at the tile edges. No pool is visible on the central lot.

detached_structure.evidence: The rear of the central house has a deck or patio area and a dark attached section. These appear connected to the main house, not separate buildings.

signals.notes: The central house has a brown/reddish shingle roof with some uneven color and two small skylights or vents. The lot has dry, patchy lawn in front and a grassy yard behind with mature trees at the sides. The asphalt driveway on the left is empty, and the rear deck or patio is partly shaded.
